 MIREYA - Science from Korea, skincare with a multi-mechanism formula.
 Based on Korean skincare science, MIREYA develops products based on a deep understanding of each skin problem. Instead of relying on a single active ingredient, the brand chooses a multi-mechanism formula, where multiple groups of active ingredients are intentionally combined to create a more comprehensive and suitable skincare solution.
 Báo Đầu tư • 04/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Korean skincare science - the foundation of MIREYA 
 South Korea has long made its mark on the cosmetics map thanks to its ability to research formulas, develop ingredients, and apply technology to skincare products. For MIREYA, choosing South Korea as the place to develop products is not simply about origin, but also about choosing a platform that aligns with the brand's science- based skincare philosophy. 
 Mireya is researched and manufactured in South Korea to meet all standards. 
 Each MIREYA product begins with identifying the skin's problem, analyzing the relevant factors, and then selecting the appropriate group of active ingredients. Instead of placing one prominent ingredient at the center and building the entire story around it, MIREYA aims for each active ingredient to perform a specific task and complement each other within the same formula.
 This philosophy is clearly reflected in the flagship product, DeepGlow MAN-8 Serum, for oily and acne-prone skin. 8% Mandelic Acid helps remove accumulated dead skin cells, improving clogged pores and rough texture; Niacinamide, Zinc PCA, and Willow Bark help control excess oil; while Allantoin, Centella, Green Tea, and Hydroxyethyl Urea soothe and hydrate. Instead of just targeting existing pimples, the formula focuses on multiple issues commonly found in oily and acne-prone skin: excess oil, dead skin cells, clogged pores, acne, and post-acne scarring.
 Together with MAN-8, EnzyClear Gentle Cleanser completes the cleansing step for oily and acne-prone skin routines with 0.5% Salicylic Acid, Protease, and Papain to help remove excess oil and surface dead skin cells; combined with soothing and moisturizing ingredients to minimize the tight, dry feeling after washing.
 You may also like That's also how MIREYA defines "Korean Skincare Science": not to make the routine more complicated, but to make each step of the skincare process more grounded and purposeful.
 Multi-mechanism formula - where each skin problem requires more than one approach. 
 Skin rarely presents with just one problem. Oily skin can be simultaneously clogged and dehydrated; pigmented skin may have a weakened protective barrier; and the eye area, where wrinkles appear, can also be dry and dull. Therefore, a "multi-mechanism" approach is a guiding principle in MIREYA's product development. 
 A specialized product ecosystem for each skin condition, where a single product addresses and solves multiple skin problems simultaneously. 
 A prime example is Nano Skin Brightener, a brand that combines active ingredients including Arbutin, Tranexamic Acid, Tranexamoyl Dipeptide-23, Niacinamide, and Vitamin C derivatives to help treat hyperpigmentation, dark spots, and uneven skin tone. This is complemented by a system of 5 Ceramides, Cholesterol, and Phospholipids to support and strengthen the skin's protective barrier. Therefore, brightening the skin is inseparable from maintaining a stable skin foundation.
 The same philosophy continues to be reflected in other products within the ecosystem. UV Veil Daily Defense SPF50+ PA++++ combines UV protection with moisturizing and brightening support; Timecode Multi-Corrective Eye simultaneously addresses three common eye area needs: hydration, dullness, and signs of aging.
 From oily, acne-prone skin and pigmentation to sun protection and eye care, each formula may differ but all follow one principle: understand the mechanism - choose the right active ingredients - combine them according to each goal.
 You may also like Currently, MIREYA focuses on oily and acne-prone skin, with MAN-8 as its flagship product and EnzyClear as a supplementary cleansing step. This is also the first step in the brand's long-term strategy: gradually building specialized solutions based on real skin problems, rather than developing isolated products.
 For MIREYA, science doesn't need to be complicated concepts. Science lies in understanding what the skin needs, why it needs it, and how the formula will work. This is the foundation upon which the brand pursues a well-founded, purposeful, and consistent approach to skincare in every product.
 MIREYA is a South Korean cosmetics brand that develops products with a multi-mechanism formula approach to address specific skin concerns. Their current product line includes DeepGlow MAN-8 Serum and EnzyClear Gentle Cleanser for oily and acne-prone skin; Nano Skin Brightener for treating dark spots, dullness, and uneven skin tone; UV Veil Daily Defense SPF50+ PA++++ for UV protection; and Timecode Multi-Corrective Eye for specialized eye care. Of these, oily and acne-prone skin is the area MIREYA is currently focusing on for in-depth development.
